name: graphrag-chat
description: Query local GraphRAG knowledge bases using your Codex subscription.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex questions about your local knowledge graph.
interface.longDescription: Retrieves evidence from local Microsoft GraphRAG tables and uploaded source text, then lets Codex reason over it without a separate query API key.
interface.defaultPrompt: Query my local GraphRAG knowledge base and answer with evidence from my documents.
